description: This file defines an abstract class em_capability_t for managing Wi-Fi mesh network capabilities and related messaging, including functions for creating TLVs, handling capability queries/reports, and managing agent state.

classes.name: em_capability_t
classes.description: An abstract class encapsulating Wi-Fi mesh capability management, message handling, and TLV creation functions, designed to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: send_client_cap_query
methods.description: Sends a capability query to a client.

methods.name: send_client_cap_report_msg
methods.description: Sends a capability report message to a BSSID for a client MAC address.

methods.name: send_bsta_cap_query_msg
methods.description: Sends a backhaul station capability query message.

methods.name: send_bsta_cap_report_msg
methods.description: Sends a backhaul station capability report message.

methods.name: create_ap_cap_report_msg
methods.description: Creates an AP capability report message.

methods.name: int get_cap_query_tx_count()
methods.description: Returns the number of capability query transmissions.

methods.name: void set_cap_query_tx_count(unsigned int cnt)
methods.description: Sets the number of capability query transmissions.

methods.name: process_msg
methods.description: Processes a message with given data and length.

methods.name: process_agent_state
methods.description: Handles the current state of the agent.

methods.name: handle_state_client_cap_report
methods.description: Handles the state of client capability report.

methods.name: handle_bsta_radio_cap
methods.description: Handles backhaul station radio capability TLV.

ctags.name: set_cap_query_tx_count
ctags.pattern: /^	void set_cap_query_tx_count(unsigned int cnt) { m_cap_query_tx_cnt = cnt; }$/
